name: xHamster
summary: Feature-rich free tube combining a deep amateur catalog, modern filtering, and an integrated paid studio clip store via Faphouse.
ranking_rationale: Stands out among major tubes for strong amateur/homemade depth and sharp duration/resolution filters, offset by busy cam-banner cross-promotions.

pricing.model: Ad-supported free tube + separate paid studio clips (Faphouse)
pricing.free_tier: Free tube videos, creator feeds, and erotica with ads
pricing.notes: Core tube is free; Faphouse studio passes and integrated live cams are billed separately. Check official checkout.

pros: Clean modern player with granular duration, date, and 4K filters
Active community playlists and creator profile pages
Integrated VR video category on the free tier
cons: Heavy cross-promotion of live cam rooms across browse pages
Regional age-verification blocks in several jurisdictions
Faphouse paywalled clips mix into standard search results

facts.value: Free adult video tube and creator hub
